source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 无锋归鞘，木族叮嘱
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC11 after EP02 SC10 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the white-clothed woman explaining Wufeng as a Wood Tribe divine artifact, returning the broken sword to Tuobaye, warning him not to reveal it lightly, and shifting attention to the Chana Fanghua tune.
title: 无锋归鞘，木族叮嘱

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC10 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC10 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH02 costume color and SH03 sword length need production regeneration.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子低声道：“人有情，剑无锋。这柄剑原是我族七大神器之一，想不到这两百多年的流离辗转，竟然是沉没在龙潭之底。”
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野听不明白无锋的旧事，却看出此剑与白衣女子渊源极深，愿意把剑物归原主，并为自己弄断剑而惶恐。白衣女子叹息剑断情伤，认为这是天意，断剑在潭底两百年后被拓拔野得到，说明他与此剑有缘。她左手轻展，断剑无声飞回，恰好插入拓拔野腰间绿竹剑鞘。白衣女子凝视拓拔野，询问他是哪族人；拓拔野茫然不知。她便嘱咐他将无锋收好，不要轻易出示，若被人看见就说自己是木族人，以免招惹麻烦。随后她看向地上的竹笛，询问拓拔野从何处听得刹那芳华曲。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后拓拔野讲述南际山顶邂逅神农、接受临终重托、跌入龙潭等经历；白衣女子听到神农百草毒发和刹那芳华曲时神色震动。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute, and broken Wufeng at the right waist.

Wufeng should return to the right-waist green bamboo sheath as a broken plain blue-grey sword. Do not render readable 神农, 空桑, 木族, or any other Chinese characters; use abstract glow lines only if needed.
White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, water/rain-associated, fully clothed, and emotionally restrained after the tear beat.
The emotional beats are remorse, gentle absolution, destined ownership, solemn warning, Tuobaye's grateful awkwardness, and the hook toward the flute tune.
Setting remains moonlit Tianhu bamboo pavilion/lakeside, bamboo shadows, mist, and faint incense smoke.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, plaques, UI, or clear inscriptions.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no flute/xiao audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable sword-return, sheath, restrained face, flute glance, and reaction beats. Avoid lip-sync, readable inscription closeups, and fast body turns.

suggested_shots.title: 断剑归鞘
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The broken Wufeng floats back by invisible force and slides precisely into Tuobaye's right-waist green bamboo sheath; keep the sword plain and non-readable.

suggested_shots.title: 木族叮嘱
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The white-clothed woman solemnly warns Tuobaye to keep Wufeng hidden and, if questioned, claim Wood Tribe identity; Tuobaye listens wide-eyed and grateful.

suggested_shots.title: 曲名刹那芳华
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The woman notices the green bamboo flute on the ground or at Tuobaye's side, her gaze changing as she asks about the Chana Fanghua tune; Tuobaye is startled, preparing to recount Shennong's final trust.
